tasks.title: Minimap draws no unit dots; a player cannot see where the men are
tasks.why: HudMinimap.cs:1 says the minimap shows 'both sides' men as dots' and Refresh() runs every HudController tick (HudController.cs:316), but all 6 HUD captures taken over a running 90+s match (ticks 1605-2957, both sides fighting: 'vs 2' losses counter climbing) show only the trench lines and the camera-frame box on the minimap -- zero dots anywhere, in close, standard, far, armed, orders and banner frames alike. Captures/hud/minimap-crop.png is a 3x crop of the exact minimap-bezel rect (hud-standard.png.json: [1455,14,448,169]); it is empty of dots. At a glance the minimap is the one HUD element meant to answer 'where is the fight', and right now it only answers 'where are the trenches'.
tasks.done_when: A fresh HudCapture.Shoot() mid-match, cropped to the minimap-bezel rect from its sidecar, shows non-background pixels in the Mine/Theirs dot colours (Color32 0xC8C9C6 / 0xB5523A) somewhere inside the bezel.

tasks.title: Aim-mode hint text has no plate; low-contrast over a bright battlefield
tasks.why: Arming a support ability shows HudText.AimHint ('Click the map to fire.  Tab changes the pattern.  Esc or right click cancels.') via HudView.ShowHint. Its only styling is `.hud-hint { ... -unity-text-align: middle-center; color: var(--tw-text-bright); display: none; }` (BattleHud.uss:59) -- no background, no border, no text-shadow. In Captures/hud/hud-armed.png and hud-orders.png the line sits mid-screen directly over burning wreckage and bright ground lamps with nothing behind it; it is the only instruction telling the player how to fire an armed ability, and it is plain bright text on a frame that is already full of bright warm highlights.
tasks.done_when: `.hud-hint` (or a wrapping element) has a backing plate or shadow strong enough that a HudCapture taken over a lit/bright crop of the battlefield still reads the line at normal contrast; a before/after pair over the same armed-ability pose shows the difference.
